## Contributor checklist

- [ ] This contribution contains no authentic client data, credentials, token fragments, account identifiers, private paths, hostnames, confidential screenshots, or unredacted logs.
- [ ] Examples and fixtures are fictional or fully sanitized.
- [ ] Provider-specific changes stay in the correct Claude or Codex namespace and do not weaken the shared core.
- [ ] I have not replaced a published ZIP, changed a published checksum, or expanded a tested-host claim without separate release review.
- [ ] I have authority to contribute this material under GPL-3.0-or-later and have preserved the vendored MIT notices where applicable.
